prompt:
Build a dynamically simulated humanoid that walks forward on a flat ground plane. The physical mechanism must include an articulated body, two feet with actual ground contact, and six finite-torque lower-body actuators at the bilateral hip, knee, and ankle joints. Use closed-loop feedback from measured body motion, joint state, and foot contact to keep the humanoid upright, limit lateral and vertical deviation, and sustain forward walking without prescribing the body trajectory.

Read FootFrictionScale, TorqueLimitScale, and InitialHeight_m from MATLAB base-workspace variables. Support FootFrictionScale from 0.75 to 1.00, TorqueLimitScale from 0.85 to 1.00, and InitialHeight_m from 1.50 m to 1.54 m. These inputs must affect the connected contact, actuator-limit, and initial-condition mechanisms respectively.

Record complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named TorsoState, JointState, FootContact, ControlAction, JointTorque, and TaskState. TorsoState has 11 channels in this order: roll, pitch, yaw deflection (rad); roll, pitch, yaw rate (rad/s); lateral and vertical displacement (m); and lateral, forward, and vertical velocity (m/s). JointState has 12 channels: right hip, knee, and ankle angle and rate, followed by left hip, knee, and ankle angle and rate, using rad then rad/s for each joint. FootContact has 2 channels [right contact,left contact]. ControlAction has 6 channels [right hip,knee,ankle action,left hip,knee,ankle action]. JointTorque has 6 channels in the same joint order, all in N*m. TaskState has 3 channels [forward position (m), instantaneous reward, termination flag]. The recorded signals must be measured from the connected physical and control paths.

Save the completed model as cand_XROBO06.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XROBO06.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
